author: Claude (English teacher role)
basis: Rewritten from the A2 column of sheet 'SDG 13-1' in SDGs Pecha Kucha (公用)_new.xlsx. Same meaning, same slide order, same key facts (Net Zero 2050, wind, smart grids, carbon capture, greenwashing). Spec: <=32 words per slide, <=10 words per sentence, present simple, high-frequency vocabulary.

slides.1: Our summers are very long and hot. The world has a big climate problem. We see strong storms everywhere. Today I talk about our planet.
slides.2: SDG 13 means Climate Action. Every country must make less dirty air. Every country must get ready for storms. The goal is a cooler Earth.
slides.3: Taiwan is a small island. Typhoons and high seas hurt us. Our factories use a lot of electricity. Can a small island help the world?
slides.4: Taiwan gets hot faster than other places. Hot days change our food and water. We must act now. We need a good plan very soon.
slides.5: Taiwan uses too much coal and oil. Coal and oil make dirty air. Our chip factories need power all day. Can we stop the pollution?
slides.6: Now we ask two hard questions. Is our life safe for the future? Can we use green power soon? Students must help answer them.
slides.7: Here is good news. Taiwan has a new climate law. Our goal is Net Zero by 2050. Companies pay money when they make dirty air.
slides.8: Look at the sea. There are many new wind turbines. Wind power grows fast in Taiwan. Schools and factories put solar panels on the roof.
slides.9: People in Taiwan recycle very well. We ride the MRT every day. Green living is popular. But is recycling enough? We need bigger changes.
slides.10: Science can help us. We build smart grids. They use AI to share electricity. Smart grids stop energy waste. Our power system works better.
slides.11: Carbon capture is a new tool. Scientists catch bad air from factory chimneys. Then they keep it deep underground. This tool cleans our air.
slides.12: Look at our streets. Taiwan is famous for electric scooters. They use batteries, not gasoline. They make less dirty air and less noise.
slides.13: Green change is not easy. New technology is very expensive. Small shops worry about the cost. How can we help everyone pay for it?
slides.14: Our factories need power all day and all night. But wind and sun need good weather. Do we need other power too? There is no easy answer.
slides.15: Climate change has no borders. Taiwan has good technology. We want to share it with other countries. A storm in one place hurts everyone.
slides.16: We must be careful. Some companies say they are green, but they do not change. We call this greenwashing. Students must check the data.
slides.17: Taiwan is doing a good job. We have a law, wind power, and smart tools. We are becoming a green island. The road is hard but right.
slides.18: Why is this important to you? You are the future. You can study science. You can save energy at home. Your voice can change people.
slides.19: Do not be afraid. Be excited to help. Taiwan has smart people and kind hearts. Let us build a clean world with blue skies.
slides.20: The clock is ticking. The Earth needs our help. Will you join the solution? Taiwan is ready for SDG 13, and so am I. Thank you.
